NUTRITION
  ENERGY:
    calories 1700
    protein_g 130
    carbs_g 140
    fats_g 60
  MEAL_TIMING:
    - "Distribute carbs mainly around workouts and earlier in day; include 20–40g low-GI carbs at breakfast and pre-workout, 20–40g post-workout."
    - "Aim 3–4 meals/day; avoid large late-night carb loads; finish last meal 2–3h before bed."
    - "On rest days: reduce carbs to 120g, add 10g fats to maintain satiety."
  CARB_QUALITY:
    - "Favor low-GI, high-fiber sources: oats, quinoa, brown rice, lentils, beans, chickpeas, sweet potato, berries, apples, non-starchy veg."
    - "Limit refined sugars/juices; choose whole fruit over juice."
    - "Target 30–40g fiber/day via legumes, vegetables, chia/flax."
  PROTEIN_SOURCES:
    - "Lean meats, fish, eggs, Greek yogurt, cottage cheese, tofu, tempeh, legumes; distribute 25–40g protein per meal."
  FAT_SOURCES:
    - "Olive oil, avocado, nuts, seeds, fatty fish 2x/week for omega-3."
  HYDRATION:
    - "2–3L water/day; include 1–2 cups coffee or tea if desired without added sugar."
  MICRONUTRIENTS:
    - "Emphasize magnesium, potassium, and chromium from leafy greens, legumes, nuts, and whole grains."
  DIABETES_CONSIDERATIONS:
    - "Coordinate metformin timing with meals; monitor pre- and post-exercise glucose (pre 90–250 mg/dL is acceptable; treat if <90)."
    - "Carry fast-acting carbs (glucose tabs) during sessions in case of unexpected lows."
    - "Avoid training if symptomatic hyperglycaemia with ketones; prioritize steady-state cardio after meals to blunt glucose spikes."
  SAMPLE_DAY:
    - "Breakfast: Greek yogurt (200g) + berries (100g) + 30g oats + 10g chia; coffee."
    - "Lunch: Lentil salad: 150g cooked lentils, mixed greens, tomato, cucumber, olive oil (1 tbsp), feta, apple."
    - "Pre-workout: small banana or 120g sweet potato + 25g whey."
    - "Dinner: Salmon 150g, quinoa 120g cooked, roasted broccoli; olive oil (1 tsp)."
    - "Optional snack: cottage cheese 150g + walnuts 10g or celery + hummus."
  BEHAVIOR:
    - "Aim 7000–9000 steps/day on non-cardio days."
    - "Eat slowly, prioritize vegetables first, plate method: 1/2 non-starchy veg, 1/4 lean protein, 1/4 low-GI carbs."
    - "Weekly check-ins: weight, waist, fasting glucose; adjust calories by 100–150 if weight loss stalls >2 weeks."
  ADJUSTMENTS:
    - "If fasting glucose >130 mg/dL persistently, bias carbs away from breakfast and add post-meal walks 10–15m."
    - "If energy low and recovery poor, increase carbs by 20–30g on training days, maintain protein."

  MEAL_TIMING:
    - "Distribute carbs around resistance workouts and earlier in the day; include 20–40g low-GI carbs pre/post resistance sessions."
    - "On fasted cardio mornings: water/black coffee allowed; eat first meal within 60–90 minutes after finishing. If waking glucose <90 mg/dL or symptomatic, consume 10–15g fast carbs before cardio."
    - "Aim 3–4 meals/day; finish last meal 2–3h before bed. On rest days reduce carbs to 120g and add 10g fats."
  WEEKLY_FLEX_MEAL:
    - "1 meal per week up to +600 calories above daily target or max 2300 total for that day (whichever is lower)."
    - "Prioritize protein ≥35g and vegetables; cap added sugars ~40g; avoid alcohol or limit to 1 drink."
    - "Best timing: within 2–4h post-resistance workout or after a brisk 20–30m walk; walk 10–15m post-meal."
    - "If fasting glucose >130 mg/dL on ≥3 days that week, skip the flex meal the following week."
  IF_PROTOCOL:
    - "Optional: 14:10 fasting:eating window daily. Progress to 16:8 only if glucose and energy are stable for 2+ weeks."
    - "Fasted morning cardio allowed within fasting window; break the fast within 60–90 minutes after finishing."
    - "On training days ensure at least 2 meals plus a protein feeding post-workout within the window."
  CARB_QUALITY:
    - "Favor low-GI, high-fiber carbs: oats, quinoa, brown rice, lentils, beans, chickpeas, sweet potato, berries, apples, non-starchy veg."
    - "Limit refined sugars/juices; choose whole fruit; target 30–40g fiber/day."
  PROTEIN_SOURCES:
    - "Lean meats, fish, eggs, Greek yogurt, cottage cheese, tofu, tempeh, legumes; distribute 25–40g per meal."
  FAT_SOURCES:
    - "Olive oil, avocado, nuts, seeds; fatty fish 2x/week."
  HYDRATION:
    - "2–3L water/day; 300–400ml before fasted cardio; coffee/tea without sugar if desired."
  MICRONUTRIENTS:
    - "Emphasize magnesium, potassium, chromium via leafy greens, legumes, nuts, whole grains."
  DIABETES_CONSIDERATIONS:
    - "Coordinate metformin with meals; monitor glucose pre/post exercise (acceptable pre 90–250 mg/dL)."
    - "Carry fast-acting carbs during sessions; avoid training with symptomatic hyperglycaemia with ketones."
    - "Use steady-state cardio after meals to blunt spikes; prioritize post-meal walks 10–15m."
  SAMPLE_DAY:
    - "Breakfast (post-fasted cardio): Omelet (2 eggs + 100g egg whites) with spinach, 1 slice whole-grain toast, 1/2 avocado."
    - "Lunch: Lentil salad (150g cooked) + mixed greens + tomato + cucumber + olive oil 1 tbsp + feta + apple."
    - "Pre-resistance: small banana or 120g sweet potato + whey 25g."
    - "Dinner: Salmon 150g, quinoa 120g cooked, roasted broccoli + olive oil 1 tsp."
    - "Optional snack: Greek yogurt 200g + berries 100g or cottage cheese 150g + walnuts 10g."
  POST_WORKOUT_SNACKS:
    - "Greek yogurt 200g + berries 100g + chia 10g."
    - "Whey 25–30g in water + small banana."
    - "Cottage cheese 200g + small apple."
    - "Tuna pouch 90g + 4–6 whole-grain crackers."
    - "Turkey 100g + baby carrots 150g + hummus 40g."
  ADJUSTMENTS:
    - "If weight loss stalls >2 weeks, reduce calories by 100–150 or cap flex meal at +300 (max 2000 that day)."
    - "If fasting glucose >130 mg/dL persistently, shift eating window earlier, bias carbs to mid-day, add 10–15m walks after meals."
    - "If energy or recovery poor, increase carbs by 20–30g on training days while maintaining protein."
    - "If morning fasted cardio feels easy (RPE <4) for 1 week, add 2 minutes per session up to 30 minutes max in Phases 2–3."
